audit_result: No existing untouched Research2 EVAL trace/capture artifacts found in repository evidence/data paths during R2-09B contract freeze (search over tracked repo paths for EVAL/r2 trace/capture artifacts). Absence is documented; R2-09B freezes acquisition/design contract only.

design_decision.label: DESIGN_DECISION_NOT_STATISTICALLY_POWERED
design_decision.choice: Retain minimal balanced held-out design: 4 new EVAL workload specifications = 1 held-out workload instance per nominal category (coding, reasoning, summarization, instruction), 1 deterministic capture each = 4 primary EVAL capture cells. No prospective expansion performed before R2-09A.
design_decision.confirmatory_scope: Primary confirmatory claims are limited to these four frozen held-out workload instances/specs. A single instance does not by itself establish generalization across an entire workload family/category. Family/category-level generalization is unmeasured.
design_decision.rationale: Minimal balanced design supports per-instance reporting without inventing sample size or adding EVAL instances post hoc. Not statistically powered.

model_identity.status: MUST_MATCH_FROZEN_RESEARCH2_PROTOCOL_AT_ACQUISITION; record actual artifact path/SHA in acquisition manifest

deterministic_capture_conditions.seed_policy: Record explicit acquisition seed per cell; deterministic decoding protocol follows II-B/R2-08 convention. Seed field is metadata/replicate identifier; any seed effect under deterministic greedy decoding must be reported, not assumed zero.
deterministic_capture_conditions.context_limits: Record actual context/runtime limits in acquisition manifest; must be consistent across a cell comparison unless explicitly versioned.
deterministic_capture_conditions.expert_memory_capture_budget_relevance: Expert-memory budget is a replay/evaluation parameter (1.5/4/8 GiB primary). Trace capture budget/configuration must be recorded and consistent with Research2 trace schema/protocol.

trace_schema_and_validation.trace_schema: Research2 R2Trace/routing trace schema used by canonical II-A/II-B pipeline (or explicitly versioned compatible schema)
validation_requirements: SHA256 recorded for trace and workload spec
replay contract compatibility checks pass before EVAL analysis
rejection_retry_rules: retry at most once per cell with identical frozen spec; if retry differs, record both and mark cell INCONCLUSIVE pending review
do not tune prompts/specs after observing EVAL trace quality except by creating a new benchmark version

state_machine: EVAL_CAPTURED_SEALED (captured, not inspected for method selection)
acquisition_protocol.when_results_visible: No EVAL performance/result may be inspected until B_selected (R2-09A) and the selected R2-10 predictor/config are frozen under this contract and EVAL_OPENED is recorded.
acquisition_protocol.post_eval_method_change: Creates a new experimental generation/version; old EVAL becomes DEV/observed for that new generation and a new held-out EVAL is required for fresh confirmatory claims.

eval_workload_specs.description: Held-out EVAL coding spec; new task, no reuse of Research2 DEV prompts. Confirmatory scope is limited to this held-out instance; not a claim of generalization across the full nominal workload category.

Held-out EVAL reasoning spec; new analytical task, no reuse of R2-08 DEV prompts. Confirmatory scope is limited to this held-out instance; not a claim of generalization across the full nominal workload category.

Held-out EVAL summarization spec with committed local source; no web/network dependency; no reuse of R2-08 DEV prompts. Confirmatory scope is limited to this held-out instance; not a claim of generalization across the full nominal workload category.

Held-out EVAL instruction/expository spec; new task, no reuse of R2-08 DEV prompts. Confirmatory scope is limited to this held-out instance; not a claim of generalization across the full nominal workload category.

spec_visibility.rationale: Exact EVAL workload spec/prompt files are stored in the tracked repository for immutable provenance and SHA binding. In a repository-accessible workflow this does not prevent reading prompt content before method freeze; therefore the benchmark is not claimed as fully blinded to EVAL task content.
controls: EVAL performance/results remain locked and must not be inspected until B_selected and selected R2-10 predictor/config are frozen and EVAL opening is recorded.
Prompt-specific feature/model engineering tailored to exact EVAL prompt/task content is prohibited.
No EVAL result may be used for tuning/selection/metric/threshold/falsification changes or candidate addition/removal while reporting held-out EVAL.
Violation or prompt-content-driven overfitting risk must be reported as a benchmark-integrity limitation.
